Wild Ones Event History · 2022–2026

From California roots to a Hawaiʻi Island production.

The Wild Ones story spans recruitment, travel, shared event experiences and the evolution into large-format production on Hawaiʻi Island. This timeline preserves that history while keeping current venue case studies clearly documented.

Featured Event · Hawaiʻi Island · September 6, 2026

NOCTURNE 2026

Four years after the earliest events in this archive, NOCTURNE brought the Wild Ones vision into a full 12-hour EDM festival environment on Hawaiʻi Island with DJs, lighting, a covered dance floor, hospitality, controlled entry and a 3 AM close.

The next chapter

The idea became a place to build experiences.

The archive begins with California events and destination experiences. The current chapter is rooted on Hawaiʻi Island, where Wild Ones now develops producer-facing grounds for concerts, EDM events, festivals and large-format productions.

The archive will keep growing

Every completed production can become part of the record.

Historical photo galleries preserve the Wild Ones story. Current case studies add producer-level documentation around layout, production, audience experience and operations.
